evidenceType: 固定两版本的只读生产构建；补全启动预热根后的静态归属
scope: 仅静态闭包；模块长度UTF-16码元，gzip为构建估算。静态启动根不包括所有路由进入后动态加载的模块，尤其Design实际工作区先加载会话；不能把全部nativeIncremental当作两模式实际新增网络字节。

profiles.scope: Static production chunks only; gzip is a local estimate, module lengths are UTF-16 code units. Warm app chunks are subtracted. Browser network, Workers, PSS and timing need the unchanged authenticated benchmark.
